A four-operation RichTextCodec Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must formalize the contract so that fit and normalize steps remain composable separately as existing Cloud callers require
AdfCodec implementation must live in adapters/jira/ and WikiTextCodec in adapters/jira_family/ to preserve import boundaries, with no new ADF references introduced outside codecs

Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the shared jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, taking RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency, while location-pinned modules and inbound seams retain their direct ADF calls
WikiTextCodec must truncate at 32767 characters using the marker " … [truncated by reconciler]" (matching ADF's existing marker) and counted against the limit
J1's pinned Cloud oracles must pass unmodified after relocating fit and normalize composition to the codec, proving behavior preservation
